comparison.objective: Open three breaker terminals, insert a comb busbar into all simultaneously, then tighten them.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated screwdriver engagement, multi-pin alignment/insertion, and sequential clamp tightening.
comparison.success_condition: All pins are home and square, all screws clamp them, the comb withstands a 10 N pull, and tool/hands clear.
comparison.reason: This has tool use and tightening, but its tested ability is row-wide multi-pin insertion into pre-opened clamps, not adjustment of a moving collar followed by dynamic-response iteration.
